title_sq: Duplex ne shitje tek Swan Lake Residence, Buze Liqenit te Farkes (ID D8142A-20)
description_sq:
Tek Swan Lake Residence, pozicionuar buze Liqenit te Farkes, Shitet Duplex 2+1 +2 tualete me siperfaqe totale 124.4 m², nga te cilat:
Siperfaqe fizike: 122 m²
Siperfaqe e perbashket 2.4 m²
Projekti eshte ne faze ndertimi - parashikohet qe afati i perfundimit eshte fundi i veres 2026.
Duplexi zhvillojet ne 2 kate funksionale, ku kati i pare organizohet ne sallon se bashku me kuzhinen dhe 1 tualet dhe kati i dyte ne 2 dhoma gjumi dhe 1 tualet (per me shume detaje, shikoni planimetrine tek fotot)
Swan Lake Residence eshte nje rezidence elitare, e cila nderthur ne menyre harmonike natyren me dizajnin elegant, duke ofruar nje pervoje jetese te qete dhe te rafinuar.
E projektuar per te rritur cilesine e jeteses, Rezidenca Swan Lake do te ofroje gjithashtu sherbime te integruara, duke siguruar rehati, komoditet dhe nje stil jetese te orientuar drejt mireqenies dhe luksit te perditshem.
Duplexi disponon dokumentacion te rregullt nga firma e ndertimit.
Ofrohen dhe poste parkimi ne shitje me cmim ekstra, nga 25 000€ - 30 000 €
(ne varesi te m² dhe pozicionimit te postit te parkimit)
Cmimi: 190 000 euro
title_en: Duplex for sale at Swan Lake Residence, Farke Lakeside (ID D8142A-20)
description_en: At Swan Lake Residence, located on the edge of Lake Farka, Duplex 2+1 +2 bathrooms with a total area of 124.4 m² is for sale, of which: Physical area: 122 m² Total area 2.4 m² The project is in the construction phase - it is expected that the completion date is the end of summer 2026. The duplex is developed on 2 functional floors, where the first floor first is organized in the living room together with the kitchen and 1 bathroom and the second floor in 2 bedrooms and 1 bathroom (for more details, see the floor plan in the photos) Swan Lake Residence is an elite residence, which harmoniously combines nature with elegant design, offering a quiet and refined living experience. Designed to enhance the quality of life, the Swan Lake Residence will also offer integrated services, ensuring comfort, convenience and a lifestyle oriented towards well-being and everyday luxury. The duplex has regular documentation from the construction company. Parking spaces are also available for sale at an extra price, from €25,000 - €30,000 (depending on the m² and positioning of the parking space) Price: 190,000 euros
